$comment: The magnitude ratchet for the S0 CLI membrane (Track 53 T53.02).
Track 53's own diagnosis of how the architecture was lost: 'legacyForbiddenImportAllowlist
is a boolean permit with no magnitude, so 41 -> 59 files never once turned a gate red.'
Licensing epi-logos as a composition root (Architect ruling 2026-07-28) removes the
false signal but would leave the same blind spot, because a licence is also a boolean.
So the constraint on the membrane is not WHETHER it reaches other layers -- reaching them
is its function -- but HOW MUCH LAW it holds while doing so. This file records that
magnitude. The gate fails when the count RISES. Each drain tranche (T53.04-T53.08) lowers
the number as it moves handlers to their coordinate, and the ratchet makes the reduction
irreversible. T53.11 replaces the count with zero and the structural guard.
A file counts as law-bearing when it names an S1/S2/S3/S5 crate. A CLI wrapper that only
parses argv and prints does not; a handler body does.
RELATED, NOT RIVAL -- read before adding a third mechanism. A categorical guard already
exists at Body/S/S0/epi-cli/tests/s0_membrane_guardrails.rs, with its own inventory at
contract-inventory/s0-membrane-inventory.json: it asks, per file, whether a downstream-law
module is inventoried, carries an `// S0 ADAPTER: Body/S/<...>` annotation, or sits in a
baseline CLI-glue list. That guard answers 'is this file accounted for?'. This ratchet
answers 'is there more law than yesterday?' -- the question a per-file permit cannot ask,
and the one whose absence let 41 files become 59. Keep both; T53.11 folds them together
when the count reaches zero.
NOTE 2026-07-28: s0_does_not_introduce_new_downstream_service_law is currently RED with 6
unannotated modules (gate/day_start.rs, gate/nara_close_bundle.rs, gate/epii_axiom.rs,
gate/verifier.rs, gate/tuning.rs, gate/codon.rs). That predates Track 53 and is part of what
the drain resolves -- do not silence it by adding baseline entries.
LINE CEILING added 2026-07-28 during T53.04. The file count alone is too coarse to
see a drain in progress: s1_hen.rs went from 978 lines to 110 when the s1'.* handlers
moved to hen-compiler-core, but it still names an S2 crate for the one composite that
legitimately stays, so the file count did not move at all. A ratchet that cannot see
real progress will not be trusted, and a ratchet that is not trusted gets raised.
Both numbers may only fall.
SCOPE WIDENED to the whole crate 2026-07-28 (T53.08). The roots were gate/ + graph/, which
left the tail ungoverned: agent/, nara/, portal/, tui/ and bimba.rs all reach S-crates and
nothing measured them. The categorical guard (s0_membrane_guardrails.rs) does not cover them
either -- its law zones are gate/, graph/, vault/, core/ -- so a handler added under agent/
would have raised no alarm at all. T53.08's own brief names that risk: 'this is the tail where
it was easier silently becomes the next allowlist.'
The ratchet is the right instrument for it precisely because it counts only files that NAME an
S-crate. Widening the zones of the categorical guard instead would have flagged dozens of
innocent files that reference nothing; widening the ratchet flags exactly the law-bearing ones.
56 files / 14,077 lines under gate+graph becomes 77 / 22,287 across the crate -- the extra 21
files are the audited tail, every one of them CLI passthrough today (see
plan.runs/53.T53.08-tail-residency-audit.md). From here the whole membrane may only shrink.

baseline.note: Residency baseline 2026-05-06 (c3f39763) was 41 files under gate/ alone; it had grown to 59 files / 15,720 law-bearing code lines across gate+graph by the time this ratchet landed. That growth is the failure this file exists to make impossible. T53.04 took it to 14,940.
baseline.metric: CODE lines only — blank lines and `//` comments excluded. Raw-line counting made the ratchet measure text rather than law: adding the `// S0 ADAPTER:` ownership annotation that s0_membrane_guardrails.rs requires raised the count by 3 and turned the gate red for documenting residency correctly. A gate that punishes the thing the architecture asks for gets raised rather than obeyed, so the metric was fixed instead of the ceiling.
progress: T53.05/06/07 (2026-07-28): 59 files / 14,940 lines -> 56 files / 14077 lines. The s2 graph family, s3-prime temporal context and the s5-prime improve/review/tune/epii families reached their coordinates; gate/{improve,review,tuning,epii_axiom}.rs are deleted outright.
baseline.scope: Body/S/S0/epi-cli/src (whole crate). Was gate/ + graph/ only, until T53.08.

target.note: At zero the ceiling is redundant and the structural guard replaces it: gate/ holds only CLI wrappers, graph/ only argv-and-print.
